_why._note: Betaflight aircraft (msp_link.py). Kept in betasim/profiles: betasim/enable.sh applies betasim/patches (they add msp_lock_gain and msp_gyro_lsb_per_dps to settings.py) and copies this file to tools/profiles. msp_device must be the FC's MSP UART, and mavlink-router must not hold that port.
_why.send_speed: on: msp_link sends a flow message from send_speed only; no speed, nothing sent.
_why.send_hz: 20: one rangefinder + one flow message per send = 40 of the 95 MSP commands per second; the FC needs a flow message at least every 100 ms.
_why.att_hz: 40: MSP_MULTIPLE_MSP polls (attitude, gyro, height) per second, 5 of them replaced by MSP_STATUS_EX. SITL: the FC answered 99 commands per second (betasim/results/proto.txt).
_why.min_att_hz: 25: the poll gives 35 attitude rows per second (40 minus 5 status polls) when no command is dropped.
_why.att_stale_s: 0.1: polled attitude, 25 ms period plus up to 10 ms serial task delay.
_why.msp_lock_gain: 0.2 per s: mode v2, our model: a constant speed error e gives a bounded error e / (2 x 0.2) instead of a growing one (tests_apb/test_msp_link.py F). SITL: betasim/results/matrix.txt.
_why.fc_baud: 115200: the Betaflight default MSP baud (io/serial.c); the load is about 3.2 kB/s of 11.5 kB/s.
_why.min_height_m: 3: as outdoor_day. Betaflight also needs 10 m or less: rangefinder_max_range_cm and poshold_opticalflow_max_range stop at 1000 cm.
